title: Our Purpose
description: Vision, mission, journey, philosophy, values, and compliance — the foundations that guide Hijaz Hospital's commitment to compassionate, accessible healthcare for all.

hero.title: Our Purpose
hero.excerpt: Vision, mission, journey, philosophy, values, and compliance — the foundations that guide Hijaz Hospital's commitment to compassionate, accessible healthcare for all.

vision: To develop Hijaz Hospital into a state-of-the-art secondary-level healthcare institution that serves all strata of society with excellence and compassion
mission: To care for the ailing with compassion, respect, dignity, and professional excellence, while ensuring that financial hardship never stands in the way of receiving care

journey.title: A humble beginning
body: Hijaz Hospital began as a small dispensary in Lahore, founded on the principle that quality healthcare should be accessible to all, regardless of financial means.

journey.title: Expanding services
body: The institution grew to include outpatient and inpatient services, establishing itself as a trusted welfare healthcare provider in the community.

journey.title: Modern facilities
body: Major expansion brought modern operation theatres, diagnostic facilities, and specialized departments under one roof.

journey.title: 200-bed hospital
body: Hijaz Hospital evolved into a 200-bedded charitable healthcare institution, serving thousands of patients with dignity and care.

journey.title: Continuing the mission
body: Today, more than 90% of patients receive treatment completely free of cost, fulfilling the founders' vision of compassionate, accessible healthcare for all.

philosophy.heading: A Legacy of Faith, Service, and Compassion
philosophy.body: Founded on enduring values, Hijaz Hospital has grown from a vision of service into a trusted healthcare institution. Guided by faith, compassion, and professional excellence, we are committed to providing quality healthcare that meets the physical, emotional, and social needs of our patients.

approach.title: Patient-Centered Care
approach.body: Every decision is guided by the needs, dignity, and comfort of our patients.

approach.title: Quality & Safety
approach.body: Evidence-based practices and continuous improvement ensure safe, effective treatment.

approach.title: Compassionate Service
approach.body: Healthcare delivered with empathy, respect, and cultural sensitivity.

approach.title: Community Partnership
approach.body: Working with donors, partners, and volunteers to extend our reach.

valuesIntro: At Hijaz Hospital Trust, our work is guided by compassion, integrity, excellence, and a commitment to serving humanity. We believe quality healthcare should be accessible to all, especially the deserving and underserved.

values.title: Compassion
values.body: Treating every patient with empathy and kindness.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: Upholding honesty and transparency in all we do.

values.title: Excellence
values.body: Striving for the highest standards of medical care.

values.title: Service
values.body: Dedicated to serving humanity without discrimination.

values.title: Respect
values.body: Honoring the dignity of every individual.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: Embracing modern medicine to improve outcomes.

valuesOutro: These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire our commitment to improving lives and serving our community.
complianceIntro: Hijaz Hospital is committed to adhere to all applicable healthcare regulations, quality standards, ethical practices, and governance requirements, ensuring safe, transparent, and accountable healthcare services for all.

foundersTeaser.name: Haji Inam Ellahi Asar (Late)
body: Born in October 1927 in Chiniot, he devoted more than five decades of his life to the service of humanity, earning deep respect as a distinguished social worker and philanthropist.
A highly successful businessman, he was recognized among the highest taxpayers in Pakistan during his prime years, reflecting his integrity, vision, and contribution to the nation's economy.

foundersTeaser.name: Mian Abdul Waheed (Late)
body: Born in April 1931 in East Punjab, he was a distinguished humanitarian admired for his integrity, humility, and lifelong dedication to public welfare and community service.

As a founding member and one of the principal driving forces behind the establishment of Hijaz Hospital, alongside Haji Inam Elahi Asar, he played a pivotal role in shaping the institution's mission of compassionate healthcare and social service.

items.title: Chairman's Message
items.name: Mian Muhammad Asif Waheed
body: Welcome to Hijaz Hospital, where our commitment to excellence is matched by our dedication to serving humanity.
Since its humble beginnings as a small dispensary, Hijaz Hospital has grown into a modern, multidisciplinary healthcare institution.

items.title: President's Message
items.name: Sohail Iqbal
body: It is a privilege to welcome you to Hijaz Hospital Trust, where faith, compassion, and service come together to bring hope and healing to those in need.

Our Trust was founded on the inspiring vision of Haji Inam Ellahi Asar (Late) and Alhaj Mian Abdul Waheed (Late), who believed that quality healthcare should never be beyond the reach of anyone because of financial hardship.

cards.title: Awards
cards.subtitle: Tamgha-e-Imtiaz – Government of Pakistan
cards.body: In recognition of his lifelong dedication to serving the sick and underprivileged, the Founder of Hijaz Hospital, Haji Inam Elahi Asar (Late), was honored with the prestigious Tamgha-e-Imtiaz by the Government of Pakistan for his outstanding humanitarian and social welfare services.

cards.title: Medical College Affiliation
cards.subtitle: Fatima Memorial Medical & Dental College, Lahore
cards.body: Hijaz Hospital is proud to maintain a strong academic and clinical affiliation with Fatima Memorial Hospital, Lahore, one of Pakistan's leading teaching hospitals.

cards.title: Our Trusted Healthcare Partners
cards.subtitle: Chughtai Healthcare | Al-Noor Diagnostic Centre | Harmone Lab
cards.body: To ensure that no deserving patient is deprived of essential diagnostic services, Hijaz Hospital has established strategic partnerships with Chughtai Healthcare, Al-Noor Diagnostic Centre, and Harmone Lab at specially negotiated rates.

cards.title: Welfare Sharia
cards.body: Hijaz Hospital operates a well-structured Welfare Sharia Department, which is certified and supervised by Jamia Ashrafia, Lahore, ensuring that all welfare and Zakat assistance is administered in strict accordance with Islamic Shariah principles.

departmentsTeaser.title: Medical Departments
departmentsTeaser.lede: Hijaz Hospital offers comprehensive medical and surgical care across a wide range of specialties.

items.title: Surgery & Allied Specialties
items.body: General Surgery, Orthopedics, Urology, and allied surgical specialties.
